s sports and outdoor customer base through its digital marketplaces in 20 countries
HALLANDALE BEACH, Fla., Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- NextPlat Corp (

) ("NextPlat" or the "Company"), a global consumer products and services company providing healthcare and technology solutions through e-commerce and retail channels worldwide, today announced that its UK subsidiary,

(GTC), a leading international provider of satellite communications, tracking and personal-safety equipment, has secured an agreement to sell its comprehensive catalog of satellite-enabled devices and connectivity products on Decathlon's global digital e-commerce platform. GTC will introduce a broad range of products operating on leading satellite networks including Globalstar, Iridium, and Inmarsat to Decathlon's e-commerce stores. The rollout will open access to a new customer base for GTC while bringing Decathlon's customers an expanded range of communications, navigation and outdoor connectivity products.
Founded in 1976,

is one of the world's largest sports and outdoor leisure retailers, operating more than 1,700 stores across over 70 countries and regions serving a large international community of outdoor enthusiasts, athletes and adventurers. This new online consumer sales channel will enable GTC to introduce an array of satellite-enabled communications, tracking and emergency-safety products to Decathlon's e-commerce customers in the 20 countries where its digital marketplace currently operates. GTC product listings will include popular connectivity solutions specifically designed for outdoor activities, such as hiking, cycling, sailing, camping, skiing, and expeditions, in remote areas or where reliable mobile-phone coverage may be unavailable.

David Phipps, CEO of NextPlat and Managing Director of its GTC subsidiary, said: "This new relationship brings together Decathlon's global scale and trusted e-commerce platform with GTC's specialist satellite communications expertise, reflecting our ongoing commitment to helping consumers stay connected to everything important. We look forward to offering Decathlon's sports and outdoor lifestyle customers access to some of the world's most popular connectivity products and to building sales through this large and well-established global online channel in the months ahead."

Rupert Graham, Marketplace Business Development Manager at Decathlon, commented: "We are delighted to welcome Global Telesat Communications and its specialist satellite communications range of products to the Decathlon marketplace. GTC can help our customers by providing peace of mind when adventuring beyond mobile coverage in remote areas and we look forward to working together to help more people enjoy the outdoors."

GTC has more than 18 years of industry experience and serves over 70,000 customers in more than 150 countries with satellite voice, data, personnel and asset tracking, and Internet of Things (IoT) solutions worldwide. Global Telesat is trusted by leading providers including Iridium, Globalstar, Inmarsat and Starlink and serves commercial, government, military and individual customers through more than 30 e-commerce channels.

About NextPlat Corp

NextPlat is a global consumer products and services company providing healthcare and technology solutions through e-commerce and retail channels worldwide. Through acquisitions, joint ventures, and collaborations, the Company seeks to provide access to high-quality healthcare and pharmacy services supporting patients, providers, institutions, and public-sector organizations and creating online sales channels for the sales of products to domestic and international consumers. Through its subsidiaries, NextPlat provides pharmacy and healthcare data management services and prescription fulfillment services in the United States and operates an e-commerce division offering voice, data, tracking, and IoT products and services worldwide.
About Decathlon

A global multi-specialist sports brand catering to beginners and top athletes, Decathlon is an innovative maker of sporting goods for all skills. With more than 100,000 teammates and 1,700 stores worldwide, Decathlon and its teams have been working ever since 1976 to fulfil an ongoing ambition: to make sport accessible to all.
